training_snapshot.scope: One claim of latest regular checkpoint before any new quality inference. Original V124 worker and horizon continue unchanged. Readonly inference copy preserves the exact claimed bytes; no checkpoint selection by outputs.

source_scope: Model inference uses exact original trained59-module source; current pure-NumPy reporting/audit use separately frozen64-module analysis source. Legacy missing raw_spatial_features config field is false, without graph changes.
metric_definition: Central native160 ROI, exposure-compensated camera/sRGB PSNR and linear-sRGB DCT16 annulus1/8<=frequency<1/3. Shadows receive8x/32x before scoring; ordinary/faint receive1x. Display40x is never scored. Equal arithmetic means of per-observation dB; no real-reference PSNR.

primary_independent_audit.scope: All retained material methods/CFAs and published native cells, independently recomputed. Real low-ISO and native-binned references remain approximate; no real-reference PSNR or model recommendation.

faint_supplement_scope: Exploratory finite16-observation/four-source explanation of the primary faint-ADC result; not a new benchmark, restoration correction or full-model ranking.

actual_visual_review.method: Actual native-resolution view_image inspection, without resizing.
findings: No clear large gain in noisy or exposure-compensated shadow crops; fine hairs/grass/wood remain attenuated.
Main foliage remains soft/painterly, coarse fence and building geometry coherent, sky quiet.
Extra fine mesh remains largely erased nominally; nearby profile leaves weak irregular diagonal texture, without clear correct lattice recovery. Left blue point persists.
Normal faint 8-bit panels have almost invisible differences; shared40x contrast reveals residual texture/error and soft fine detail, without a broad recovery.
actual_visual_review.unviewed_primary_triplets: Audited subsets of pixels in actually viewed comparison boards; not separately claimed as viewed.

recommendation: V120 remains general choice. Small noisy/shadow PSNR changes coexist lower selected weak gains and worse faint-ADC scores; no clear large real-mesh recovery.
limits: Partial14k within original20k control run, not full endpoint or isolated objective/architecture ablation. Only four material contexts, one draw perCFA; native binned refs approximate. Full427 photo/camera/color/fullframe and V125 mean-loss comparison pending. No primary-history point or selector change.
